notes: The ASV's marginal alternatives (betrayed; shall they put to death) do not change the token partition.
The italicized some is folded onto the partitive ἐξ under rule 11 rather than marked added; reading it as a helper on ὑμῶν remains defensible and is named in that unit's note.
θανατόω is rendered by a causative frame and rule 17 heads it on the meaning-bearing complement death, not on the light verb or the subject.
